//! Asset-free Polaris microcircuit and North Star, with shared header geometry.
use crate::{
    app::App,
    theme::{Theme, ThemeMode},
};
use ratatui::{
    Frame,
    buffer::Cell,
    layout::Rect,
    style::{Color, Modifier},
};
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum Variant {
    Welcome,
    Compact,
    Emblem,
}
impl Variant {
    fn size(self) -> (u16, u16) {
        match self {
            Self::Welcome => (15, 7),
            Self::Compact => (11, 5),
            Self::Emblem => (11, 1),
        }
    }
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub(crate) struct HeaderLayout {
    pub variant: Variant,
    pub logo: Rect,
    pub metadata: Rect,
    pub history_y: u16,
}

/// body_height excludes the composer and footer, but includes the top margin.
pub(crate) fn layout(app: &App, area: Rect, body_height: u16) -> HeaderLayout {
    // Popups keep the underlying artwork; the emblem is only an extreme height fallback.
    let variant = if body_height < 7 {
        Variant::Emblem
    } else if !app.entries.is_empty() || app.working || body_height < 11 {
        Variant::Compact
    } else {
        Variant::Welcome
    };
    let (width, height) = variant.size();
    let header_height = height.max(4);
    let (x, y) = (area.x.saturating_add(2), area.y.saturating_add(2));
    let text_x = x + width + 3;
    HeaderLayout {
        variant,
        logo: Rect::new(x, y, width, height),
        metadata: Rect::new(
            text_x,
            y + (header_height - 4) / 2,
            area.right().saturating_sub(2).saturating_sub(text_x),
            4,
        ),
        history_y: y + header_height + 1,
    }
}

// Hand-tuned, single-cell grids keep the fine outline consistent in both sizes.
const WELCOME: [&str; 7] = [
    "    │  │  │    ",
    "  ┌─┴──┴──┴─┐  ",
    "  │    ╷    │  ",
    "──┤  ╶─✦─╴  ├──",
    "  │    ╵    │  ",
    "  └─┬──┬──┬─┘  ",
    "    │  │  │    ",
];
const COMPACT: [&str; 5] = [
    "   │ │ │   ",
    " ┌─┴─┴─┴─┐ ",
    "─┤  ─✦─  ├─",
    " └─┬─┬─┬─┘ ",
    "   │ │ │   ",
];
const EMBLEM: [&str; 1] = ["    ─✦─    "];
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum Ink {
    Canvas,
    FrameHighlight,
    Frame,
    Trace,
    Star,
    Mint,
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct Stroke {
    glyph: char,
    ink: Ink,
    package: bool,
}
fn artwork(variant: Variant) -> Vec<Vec<Stroke>> {
    let rows: &[&str] = match variant {
        Variant::Welcome => &WELCOME,
        Variant::Compact => &COMPACT,
        Variant::Emblem => &EMBLEM,
    };
    rows.iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(y, row)| {
            row.chars()
                .enumerate()
                .map(|(x, glyph)| {
                    let (left, right, bottom) = match variant {
                        Variant::Welcome => (2, 12, 5),
                        Variant::Compact => (1, 9, 3),
                        Variant::Emblem => (0, 0, 0),
                    };
                    let package = variant != Variant::Emblem
                        && (left..=right).contains(&x)
                        && (1..=bottom).contains(&y);
                    let mint = matches!(
                        (variant, x, y),
                        (Variant::Welcome, 7, 2) | (Variant::Compact, 5, 0)
                    );
                    let trace = match variant {
                        Variant::Welcome => (y == 3 && (5..=9).contains(&x)) || (x == 7 && y == 4),
                        Variant::Compact => y == 2 && (4..=6).contains(&x),
                        Variant::Emblem => (4..=6).contains(&x),
                    };
                    let ink = if glyph == '✦' {
                        Ink::Star
                    } else if mint {
                        Ink::Mint
                    } else if glyph == ' ' {
                        Ink::Canvas
                    } else if trace {
                        Ink::Trace
                    } else if package && (y == 1 || (x == left && y < bottom)) {
                        Ink::FrameHighlight
                    } else {
                        Ink::Frame
                    };
                    Stroke {
                        glyph,
                        ink,
                        package,
                    }
                })
                .collect()
        })
        .collect()
}
fn ink(theme: Theme, role: Ink) -> Color {
    if !theme.color {
        return Color::Reset;
    }
    if theme.rgb && theme.mode == ThemeMode::Dark {
        match role {
            Ink::Canvas => Color::Reset,
            Ink::FrameHighlight => Color::Rgb(184, 184, 184),
            Ink::Frame => Color::Rgb(107, 107, 107),
            Ink::Trace => Color::Rgb(118, 185, 0),
            Ink::Star => Color::Rgb(36, 208, 70),
            Ink::Mint => Color::Rgb(150, 214, 172),
        }
    } else {
        match role {
            Ink::Canvas => Color::Reset,
            Ink::FrameHighlight => Color::Gray,
            Ink::Frame => Color::DarkGray,
            Ink::Trace | Ink::Star => Color::Green,
            Ink::Mint => Color::LightGreen,
        }
    }
}
fn surface(theme: Theme, package: bool) -> Color {
    if !theme.color || theme.mode == ThemeMode::Terminal {
        Color::Reset
    } else if !theme.rgb {
        Color::Black
    } else if package {
        Color::Rgb(28, 28, 28)
    } else {
        Color::Rgb(0, 0, 0)
    }
}
fn stroke_cell(stroke: Stroke, theme: Theme, ascii: bool) -> Cell {
    let glyph = if ascii {
        match stroke.glyph {
            '│' | '╷' | '╵' => '|',
            '─' | '╶' | '╴' => '-',
            '┌' | '┐' | '└' | '┘' | '┴' | '┬' | '┤' | '├' => '+',
            '✦' => '*',
            other => other,
        }
    } else {
        stroke.glyph
    };
    let mut cell = Cell::default();
    cell.set_style(theme.base().remove_modifier(Modifier::BOLD))
        .set_char(glyph)
        .set_fg(ink(theme, stroke.ink))
        .set_bg(surface(theme, stroke.package));
    cell
}
pub(crate) fn render(frame: &mut Frame, rect: Rect, variant: Variant, theme: Theme, ascii: bool) {
    let visible = rect.intersection(frame.area());
    if visible.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let cells = artwork(variant);
    for y in visible.y..visible.bottom() {
        for x in visible.x..visible.right() {
            frame.buffer_mut()[(x, y)] = stroke_cell(
                cells[(y - rect.y) as usize][(x - rect.x) as usize],
                theme,
                ascii,
            );
        }
    }
}
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::app::{Entry, EntryKind};
    use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthStr;
    #[test]
    fn header_balances_welcome_and_tracks_session_and_available_body_height() {
        let mut app = App::default();
        for (w, h) in [(120, 40), (100, 30), (80, 24), (60, 20)] {
            assert_eq!(
                layout(&app, Rect::new(0, 0, w, h), h - 4).variant,
                Variant::Welcome
            );
        }
        let area = Rect::new(0, 0, 60, 20);
        app.input.set("Typing retains the welcome star");
        assert_eq!(layout(&app, area, 11).variant, Variant::Welcome);
        assert_eq!(layout(&app, area, 10).variant, Variant::Compact);
        assert_eq!(layout(&app, area, 8).history_y, 8);
        assert_eq!(layout(&app, area, 6).variant, Variant::Emblem);
        app.entries
            .push(Entry::new(EntryKind::User, "", &["hello"]));
        assert_eq!(layout(&app, area, 16).variant, Variant::Compact);
        app.command("/model");
        assert_eq!(layout(&app, area, 16).variant, Variant::Compact);
        app.command("/clear");
        assert_eq!(layout(&app, area, 16).variant, Variant::Welcome);
    }

    #[test]
    fn fine_frames_pins_traces_and_north_star_have_exact_geometry() {
        for variant in [Variant::Welcome, Variant::Compact, Variant::Emblem] {
            let cells = artwork(variant);
            let (w, h) = variant.size();
            assert_eq!(cells.len(), h as usize);
            assert!(cells.iter().all(|r| r.len() == w as usize));
            let stars: Vec<_> = cells
                .iter()
                .enumerate()
                .flat_map(|(y, r)| {
                    r.iter()
                        .enumerate()
                        .filter_map(move |(x, s)| (s.ink == Ink::Star).then_some((x, y, s.glyph)))
                })
                .collect();
            assert_eq!(
                stars,
                match variant {
                    Variant::Welcome => vec![(7, 3, '✦')],
                    Variant::Compact => vec![(5, 2, '✦')],
                    Variant::Emblem => vec![(5, 0, '✦')],
                }
            );
            assert!(
                !cells
                    .iter()
                    .flatten()
                    .any(|s| "NV█▀▄║═╔╗╚╝".contains(s.glyph))
            );
        }
        let w = artwork(Variant::Welcome);
        for x in [4, 7, 10] {
            assert_eq!(w[0][x].glyph, '│');
            assert_eq!(w[1][x].glyph, '┴');
            assert_eq!(w[5][x].glyph, '┬');
            assert_eq!(w[6][x].glyph, '│');
        }
        for (x, y, g) in [
            (2, 1, '┌'),
            (12, 1, '┐'),
            (2, 5, '└'),
            (12, 5, '┘'),
            (2, 3, '┤'),
            (12, 3, '├'),
        ] {
            assert_eq!(w[y][x].glyph, g);
        }
        assert_eq!(w[2][7].ink, Ink::Mint);
        for (x, y) in [(5, 3), (6, 3), (8, 3), (9, 3), (7, 4)] {
            assert_eq!(w[y][x].ink, Ink::Trace);
        }
        let c = artwork(Variant::Compact);
        assert_eq!(c[0][5].ink, Ink::Mint);
        for x in [3, 5, 7] {
            assert_eq!(c[1][x].glyph, '┴');
            assert_eq!(c[3][x].glyph, '┬');
        }
        assert_eq!(c[2][4].ink, Ink::Trace);
        assert_eq!(c[2][6].ink, Ink::Trace);
    }
    #[test]
    fn every_glyph_and_ascii_mapping_is_one_cell_with_portable_palette_and_surface_rules() {
        for color in [true, false] {
            for rgb in [true, false] {
                for mode in [ThemeMode::Dark, ThemeMode::Terminal] {
                    for ascii in [true, false] {
                        let theme = Theme { color, rgb, mode };
                        for variant in [Variant::Welcome, Variant::Compact, Variant::Emblem] {
                            for s in artwork(variant).into_iter().flatten() {
                                let c = stroke_cell(s, theme, ascii);
                                assert_eq!(UnicodeWidthStr::width(c.symbol()), 1);
                                assert!(!c.modifier.contains(Modifier::BOLD));
                                assert!(!c.modifier.contains(Modifier::REVERSED));
                                assert_eq!(
                                    c.bg,
                                    if !color || mode == ThemeMode::Terminal {
                                        Color::Reset
                                    } else if !rgb {
                                        Color::Black
                                    } else if s.package {
                                        Color::Rgb(28, 28, 28)
                                    } else {
                                        Color::Rgb(0, 0, 0)
                                    }
                                );
                                if ascii {
                                    assert!(c.symbol().is_ascii());
                                }
                                if !color {
                                    assert_eq!(c.fg, Color::Reset);
                                }
                                if !rgb || mode == ThemeMode::Terminal {
                                    assert!(!matches!(c.fg, Color::Rgb(..)));
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        let t = Theme::default();
        for (role, expected) in [
            (Ink::Star, Color::Rgb(36, 208, 70)),
            (Ink::Trace, Color::Rgb(118, 185, 0)),
            (Ink::Mint, Color::Rgb(150, 214, 172)),
            (Ink::FrameHighlight, Color::Rgb(184, 184, 184)),
            (Ink::Frame, Color::Rgb(107, 107, 107)),
        ] {
            assert_eq!(ink(t, role), expected);
        }
        let ascii_emblem: String = artwork(Variant::Emblem)[0]
            .iter()
            .map(|s| stroke_cell(*s, t, true).symbol().to_owned())
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(ascii_emblem, "    -*-    ");
    }
    #[test]
    fn gray_package_and_highlight_coverage_is_bounded_and_emblem_is_unfilled() {
        for (variant, count) in [
            (Variant::Welcome, 55),
            (Variant::Compact, 27),
            (Variant::Emblem, 0),
        ] {
            let cells = artwork(variant);
            assert_eq!(cells.iter().flatten().filter(|s| s.package).count(), count);
            assert_eq!(
                cells
                    .iter()
                    .flatten()
                    .filter(|s| s.ink == Ink::Mint)
                    .count(),
                usize::from(variant != Variant::Emblem)
            );
        }
        let w = artwork(Variant::Welcome);
        for (x, y) in [(2, 1), (12, 1), (2, 2), (2, 3), (2, 4)] {
            assert_eq!(w[y][x].ink, Ink::FrameHighlight);
        }
        for (x, y) in [(2, 5), (12, 5), (12, 2), (12, 3), (12, 4), (4, 0), (0, 3)] {
            assert_eq!(w[y][x].ink, Ink::Frame);
        }
        assert!(!w[0][7].package);
        assert!(!w[6][7].package);
    }
}
